reasons.10673: EO10673 signed1956-07-16 contains seven operative sections:1 establishes Council and membership;2 program promotion and agency coordination;3 necessary department assistance, optional employee detailing/executive officer and assigned functions;4 Advisory Committee establishment, presidential designation, at-pleasure service and chair designation;5 evaluation of government/private fitness measures;6 official liaison, at-least-annual meetings, assessment and reports to President;7 protection of independent lawful agency/officer functions. OCR spaced headings caused omitted1-3 and merged4-6, corrected with seven exact original spans. Sec1 continues amended through10704 (1957-03-25),10740 (1957-11-21),10785 (1958-10-17),10931 (1961-03-29); sec3 refers dynamically to departments named in sec1. Sec4 continues as restated by10772 (1958-06-30), transferring membership/chair designations from President to Council chair and dropping the original at-pleasure wording. Under owner strike-and-insert ruling these amendments are changes in continuing text, not first cessation. Annual meetings/report preparation do not end the order; no factual completion, appointment, nonconstitution or sunset trigger is supplied or needed. EO10931 section2 revokes10704/10740/10785 only, not10673. All seven sections first end as target-order commands at11074 section6 on1963-01-08. Provisional status at2026-10-14 is NO.
reasons.10772: EO10772 signed1958-06-30 restates10673 section4: advisory establishment, members designated by Council chair, and committee chair designated by Council chair. Three exact original scopes preserve the amendment introduction and every operative sentence while excluding signature. This is a continuing amendment, not instantly spent when incorporated. EO10785 alters parent Council composition without changing its chair;10931 section1 makes HEW Secretary Council chair, thereby changing the official exercising the designation powers, but continues the parent as amended. The machine ACT:EO:10772>EO:10931 says names_target=false and reaches only10673 section1, not the target section4 amendment;10931 section2 does not list10772. Neither constitutes an earlier end. No own term, deadline, actual appointment/committee-convening or exercise-of-designation event terminates the continuing norm. EO11074 section6 directly revokes10772 by number/date on1963-01-08; all three commands first end then. Provisional status at2026-10-14 is NO.

savings: Continuing independent institutional and statutory authority is affirmatively disclosed: EO11074 section4 deems its Council a continuation of the Youth Fitness Council, section3(a) protects lawful agency/officer functions, and10673 section7 had the analogous non-impairment rule. EO11074 section6 nevertheless expressly revokes the complete targets. No target-specific savings of advisory membership powers, recurring meetings/reports, pending proceedings, accrued private rights, property transfers or other independent target commands was found. The continuation is not a claim that these target EOs remain operative. No extinction of the Council or of independent statutory authority is asserted.
shared: The complete seven-source examination from b04 is reused: EO10673,10704,10740,10772,10785,10931,11074, with eight official page images and raw hashes in b04/packet-v1/SOURCE_MANIFEST.v2.json. No new download or render was needed, and no time saving is inferred. Complete EO11074 section6 expressly revokes both10673 and10772, as well as10931. It takes effect at signing1963-01-08, with no delayed effectiveness or contingent revocation; the official page corrects OCR Jarmary and1901 to January8,1963 and March29,1961. Section4 expressly continues the Council institution, while section3(a) preserves independent statutory functions; these survive on their own authority and do not preserve or revive the revoked instruments. No target-specific continuing command, accrued private right, pending proceeding or property transfer is saved. Bounded target searches are pinned in COUNTEREVIDENCE_SEARCH.v1.json. Neither catalogue absence nor the matching editorial API/1989 observations substitutes for source examination.
